name: Non-cancelling Laplacian Determinant Substitution
description: The original matrix determinant reduced to a purely quadratic polynomial where the cubic term (representing exactly the 3-clique condition) perfectly cancelled out, making it trivial for models to algebraically deduce the triangle structure. By changing the off-diagonal weight to -2 and the diagonal baseline to 2, the determinant's polynomial expansion now retains a dominant cubic term (-14 E12 E13 E23). This breaks the static analysis shortcut, forcing models to either recognize the non-linear algebraic signature of a 3-clique or fall back to an O(N^3) brute force search which will TLE.
